0022600008.text: Boston is 0-1 and hosts New York, also 0-1, in the Celtics' second game of the 2026-27 season. The Celtics sit 11th in the East and 5th in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, while the Knicks are 8th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, also 1.5 games back. Devin Carter is out for Boston with illness, and the teams have not met yet this season, though in 2025-26 the Celtics lost the series 1-3, including a 112-106 loss in New York on April 9, 2026.
